note: Preferred POI areas curated from the profile map and the profile text: every land area is marked green, the open sea (Kelp Vale, Abyssal Depths, Stonebed Shoal) is not. The three subspecies hatch in the 19 areas named in the Profile Specific Unique Feature; courtship is at Pinnacle Hill in the south of Big Tree Overlook. The subspecies only say where an individual hatched, so their ranges overlap: each subspecies playable keeps every area, as home (its own hatching areas), border land (another subspecies hatches there, but the terrain suits its own gift) or roaming ground.

legend.gui: Gui hatching areas: the big forests (Redwoods, Wollemi, Twisted, Cedrus) plus Hollow Hills and East Passage
legend.hanqiugi: Hanqiugi hatching areas: dry rock and the salt and brackish coast, none of them with fresh water
legend.zhaoianus: Zhaoianus hatching areas: heights, wind and open water to glide across
legend.courtship: Courtship ground at the giant tree in the south of Big Tree Overlook (magenta on the profile map)

variants.name: Gui
variants.note: Born in Redwoods, Hollow Hills, Wollemi Forest, East Passage, Twisted Forest and Cedrus Forest; more stamina when climbing trees high distances.

variants.name: Hanqiugi
variants.note: Born in Dry Fang Canyon, Tallbrush Coasts, Crag Bluffs, Coastland Swamp, Mudflats, Coastal Bluffs and Palm Islands; able to go for longer without food and water.

variants.name: Zhaoianus
variants.note: Born in Big Tree Overlook, Wind Tunnels, Cliff Edge Falls, Black Fern Hills, Volcano Islands and Stillwater Bog; able to glide for longer.

others.note: Roaming ground: another subspecies hatches here. Adults may forage, follow a carnivore companion or pass through; a nest here would hatch chicks of that other subspecies.
